Clicking a card in your own graveyard that some card lets you replay says nothing when the play isn't available: the Play button simply isn't there and the player is left guessing. After this, the graveyard pile's cards carry the same kind of reason where a replay is refused. ## Why R979000 built `playReason` for hand cards and explicitly deferred graveyard plays: "Plays from the graveyard keep no such field; they can follow the same pattern later." The reducer-side reason already exists — `graveyard_play::why_graveyard_play_refused` (`crates/engine/src/graveyard_play.rs:209`) computes exactly why a play at a price is refused — but nothing projects it into the view, so `contract.ts`'s pile Play affordance appears only while `legal` lists the play and a refusal is silent. ## Proposal Following R979000's precedent (presentation only, rule 7; the field absent while any play is listed): on the viewer's own graveyard cards, while they may act and a graveyard-play permission is live but every play is refused, carry the first refusal from `why_graveyard_play_refused` on the card's view; render it in the pile browser and inspect notes as the hand card's notice is rendered. A ruling note in the same PR extends R979000's pattern per rule 3. ## Where it lands `crates/engine/src/{view_for.rs,graveyard_play.rs,play_choices.rs}`, `crates/engine/tests/rules/` (a sibling of `play_reason.rs`), `apps/web/src/game/` (pile/inspect rendering), `spec/rulings/` + `spec/INDEX.md` via `cargo jackioh spec index`; spec §10.8, R979000. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] An unplayable graveyard play shows its reason where `playReason` shows today; no field while a play is listed or on anyone else's turn - [ ] No refusal leaks hidden information (same constraint R979000 states) - [ ] Engine test beside `rules/play_reason.rs`, a web render test, ruling note + index updated, `cargo jackioh spec check` green ## Size and risks Small-medium; presentation-only per rule 7. The main care is the hidden-fact constraint on refusals, as R979000 spells out. --- Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty.
